CalloutConfig.DispatchText: Someone took a fall at the park and needs help.
CalloutConfig.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A person has fallen at the park nearby. Please respond.
CalloutConfig.EnRouteHelpText: Drive to the yellow marker, then get out and walk up to the patient.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneText: You're on scene. Check on the patient.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneVoiceLine: On scene. Checking on the patient now.
CalloutConfig.AssessmentHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to help the patient.
CalloutConfig.ConversationHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to talk to the patient.
CalloutConfig.TreatingText: Checking the injury and helping the patient...
CalloutConfig.ResolutionVoiceLine: Nice work. The patient is going to be just fine.

Injury.DispatchText: Someone slipped at the park and scraped their hands.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A person scraped their hands falling at the park. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: I slipped and scraped my hands. They sting a bit.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Let me clean those up and pop a bandage on.

Injury.TreatedText: All better! Hands cleaned and bandaged. Good as new!

Injury.DispatchText: Someone twisted their ankle falling at the park.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A person twisted their ankle at the park nearby. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: I twisted my ankle, it really hurts to stand.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Sit tight, I'll wrap that ankle and get you comfy.

Injury.TreatedText: Nice work - ankle wrapped and the patient feels much better.

Injury.DispatchText: Someone had a bad fall at the park and hurt their head.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A person had a bad fall at the park and hurt their head. Please respond quickly.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Patient
DialogueLine.Text: I hit my head when I fell... everything feels dizzy.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Stay still, you're okay. Let's get you to the hospital.

Injury.TransportedText: Great job! The patient is safely taken to the hospital for care.
